title: Green Commute Challenge
description: Log 3 public transport trips (PMPML Bus or Pune Metro) or cycling/walking instead of a personal vehicle.
requirementsSummary: GPS route log or Metro/PMPML ticket timestamp proof

title: Power Saver Sprint
description: Switch off all standby electronics and unused lights in your household before leaving rooms today.
requirementsSummary: Self-report confirmation after 9 PM

title: Waste Segregation Master
description: Properly segregate wet organic waste from dry recyclable waste for 3 consecutive days.
requirementsSummary: Photo proof of segregated home waste bins

title: Pune Urban Tree Care
description: Plant a native sapling or water and care for an existing tree in your neighborhood or balcony.
requirementsSummary: Geotagged photo proof of tree watering or planting

title: Plant-Based Feast Day
description: Choose 100% plant-based meals for an entire day to reduce agricultural carbon emissions.
requirementsSummary: Self-report meal log confirmation

title: Single-Use Plastic Shield
description: Carry your own cloth bag & water bottle while shopping in Pune markets for a week.
requirementsSummary: Photo of reusable cloth bag during market trip

title: Metro Champion
description: Take the Pune Metro across Vanaz-Ramwadi or PCMC-Swargate line for your daily travel.
requirementsSummary: GPS route track or ticket QR validation

title: Solar & Energy Audit
description: Inspect appliance power usage and switch off high-draw appliances during peak hours.
requirementsSummary: Completed home energy self-audit form

title: Eco Cold Shower
description: Take a short cold shower today to cut water-heating electricity and natural gas emissions.
requirementsSummary: Self-confirm at end of morning routine

title: Zero Plastic Shopping
description: Say no to plastic bags at grocery stores and vegetable vendors by carrying your own reusable tote bag.
requirementsSummary: Photo of cloth tote bag used during shopping

title: Local Pune Mandi Sourcing
description: Buy fresh seasonal vegetables or fruits from a local Pune farmers market instead of packaged supermarket goods.
requirementsSummary: Photo of local produce purchased at Pune market

title: Phantom Power Purge
description: Unplug all device chargers, TV consoles, and microwave standby plugs before going to bed tonight.
requirementsSummary: Self-confirm after 10 PM

title: Balcony Pollinator Care
description: Water your balcony plants and place a small water bowl for urban Pune birds and pollinators.
requirementsSummary: Photo of watered plants or bird water bowl

title: Pune Cyclist Sprint
description: Log at least 15 km of bicycle riding for daily errands or commutes across Pune this week.
requirementsSummary: GPS route activity log totaling 15+ km

title: Zero Food Waste Week
description: Plan your meals and store leftovers cleanly to ensure zero edible food is thrown into the trash all week.
requirementsSummary: Weekly meal tracking log self-confirmation

title: Pune Neighborhood Cleanup
description: Participate in or organize a 30-minute litter cleanup in your street, society garden, or local Pune park.
requirementsSummary: Photo of collected litter bags at designated disposal point

title: Native Pune Tree Plantation
description: Plant a native Pune tree sapling (Neem, Peepal, Banyan, or Karanj) in a community ground or garden.
requirementsSummary: Geotagged photo with sapling tree guard

title: Home Organic Composter Setup
description: Set up a wet waste composting pot or bokashi bin to convert all kitchen scrap into rich organic compost.
requirementsSummary: Photo of active home compost setup with wet organic waste

title: Rooftop Solar & LED Overhaul
description: Replace all household incandescent/CFL bulbs with high-efficiency LEDs or install solar water/PV panels.
requirementsSummary: Photo proof of LED installation or rooftop solar panels

title: Electric Vehicle / E-Cycle Shift
description: Test ride or switch your primary neighborhood commute vehicle to an Electric Vehicle (EV) or E-Bicycle.
requirementsSummary: GPS route log of EV or E-Bike commute
